records.text: Johnnie Moore serves on an Anti-Defamation League task force and received the Simon Wiesenthal Center’s Medal of Valor.

records.text: Marissa Streit took Candace Owens to the Simon Wiesenthal Center after the Hitler clip controversy, where they spoke in Hebrew in front of her.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: almost the way it feels to me was like, "We can save you, but here's what you have to do"—was Marissa (Marissa Streit) took me to the Simon Wiesenthal Center. ... And there was like some chief rabbi-looking character, and him and her spoke in Hebrew. I didn't understand a word of what was said in front of me. And then we left, and everything was fine.

verification.notes: Private/personal claim. No public verification possible.

records.text: The Simon Wiesenthal Center issued a statement against Candace Owens's comments regarding the 2018 Hitler clip controversy.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: And at the same time, the Simon Wiesenthal Center—and this is again another interesting piece of this—put me—like, issued a statement against my comments. Simon Wiesenthal Center—we're like the official Holocaust people—and "this girl is obviously supporting Hitler."

verification.notes: A contemporaneous Jewish Journal report embeds and quotes the Simon Wiesenthal Center’s February 8, 2019 tweet publicly criticizing Owens’s historical claims about Hitler. That directly verifies the statement.

sources.title: ADL Calls Out Candace Owens Over Hitler Comments
